answer: Each epoch the nebula board auctions only 120 slots. An applicant locks a 60-credit bond and bids for one slot, starting at 50 credits and rising by a delta of 4 credits per prior slot from the same funding root, so the k-th fake from one root bids 50 plus 4 times k minus 1. Auditors publish bids by root and reject under-step bids or a reused quartz receipt. A rented-bid ring fails because rented bids share the renter's ladder and a misbehaving slot's bond is slashed. For 1,000 fakes bids total 2,048,000 credits plus 60,000 locked bonds; one honest agent pays 50 and locks 60 once.
